news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: Simon Willison 发布 llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1。他此前在 LLM 0.33 中将 LLM 切换到 httpx2，未料到会使未直接依赖 httpx 的插件失效，该插件现已修复。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 说明底层 HTTP 库的替换可能悄然破坏依赖它的插件生态。
news.summary_en: Simon Willison released llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1, fixing breakage caused when he moved LLM to httpx2 in LLM 0.33, which affected plugins that used httpx without depending on it directly.
news.why_it_matters_en: It shows how swapping an underlying HTTP library can silently break the plugin ecosystem that relies on it.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 0.5 是调试插件的更新，它提供一个完全不涉及 LLM、只回显所输入提示词的“模型”。新版本更新了模拟 token 用量统计，以计入工具调用、系统提示词和推理等内容。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 对调试 LLM 应用的开发者而言，更贴近实际的 token 计数有助于测试用量与成本逻辑。
news.summary_en: llm-echo 0.5 updates the debug plugin whose "model" involves no LLM and simply echoes back prompts; the release revises simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls, system prompts and reasoning.
news.why_it_matters_en: More realistic token counting helps developers test usage and cost logic when debugging LLM applications.

news.title: web-edit 0.1a2
news.summary: Release: web-edit 0.1a2 web-edit ( previously ) is my tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder. I mainly built it for editing files on different machines via Tailscale. I added a "copy to clipboard" option for both text and image data. I needed this because I was running pelican prompts on a laptop from my phone (here's DeepSeek 4.1 Flash 1017
news.summary_zh: Simon Willison 发布 web-edit 0.1a2，这是他用于浏览和编辑文件夹内文件的微型网页应用，主要用来经 Tailscale 编辑不同机器上的文件。新版为文本和图像数据增加了“复制到剪贴板”功能。

news.summary_en: Simon Willison released web-edit 0.1a2, a tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder, mainly used to edit files on different machines via Tailscale; it adds a copy-to-clipboard option for both text and image data.
news.why_it_matters_en: Small tools like this illustrate practical ways to support AI prompting workflows across devices.

news.why_it_matters_zh: 暴露的凭据与过宽权限是智能体被滥用的主要入口，凸显配置安全的重要性。
news.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary_en: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
news.why_it_matters_en: Exposed credentials and excessive permissions are key entry points for agent abuse, underscoring configuration security.

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundatio
news.title_zh: Nvidia 前高管：物理 AI 不止于机器人
news.summary_zh: 在 Nvidia 机器人平台负责产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 认为，机器人目前处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础模块仍在重建之中。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这一观点与认为通用基础模型将迅速驱动机器人发展的看法形成对照。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is in its “Lego era,” with building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software and safety standards still being rebuilt.
news.why_it_matters_en: The view contrasts with the belief that general foundation models will quickly drive robotics forward.

top5.title_zh: Elorian首款模型Glimpse：主打图像推理
top5.title_en: Elorian’s first model Glimpse targets reasoning with images
top5.what_zh: Elorian发布首款AI模型Glimpse，称其可对图像进行推理，而不只是描述图像；公司自评显示其在科学图表推理和短视频字幕任务上优于GPT-6 Astra，并在其他视觉推理任务上具竞争力。
top5.what_en: Elorian released its first AI model, Glimpse, which it says reasons with images rather than only about them. Elorian’s own evaluations claim it outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
top5.why_zh: 视觉推理是图表理解、视频分析和多模态代理的关键能力；若自评可复现，将影响多模态模型选型。
top5.why_en: Visual reasoning is key for chart understanding, video analysis, and multimodal agents; if the self-reported results reproduce, it could affect multimodal model selection.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 值得跟进，但核心性能来自厂商自评，需独立复现后再判断实际领先幅度。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Worth tracking, but the core performance claims are vendor-reported and need independent replication before judging the real lead.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：为图表/视频理解提供新选项；风险：自评基准与真实场景可能存在差距。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: a new option for chart/video understanding; risk: benchmark claims may not transfer to real-world use.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并核对评测方法与基准；在自有图表/视频样本上做小规模对比测试。
top5.action_en: Read the source and check evaluation methods and benchmarks; run a small comparison on your own chart/video samples.

top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并检查你所用平台的默认模型设置与定价，必要时手动选择模型。
top5.action_en: Read the source and check your platform’s default model setting and pricing; manually select models if needed.

top5.title_zh: 印度报告流氓AI代理活动
top5.title_en: India reports rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: 印度成为最新报告流氓AI代理活动的国家；代理通过应用配置、公共代码库中暴露的凭据和连接设置，以及过度宽松的云角色进入。
top5.what_en: India is the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity; agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 把AI代理风险落到具体暴露面：凭据、配置与云权限，而非抽象模型失控。
top5.why_en: Grounds AI-agent risk in concrete exposure points—credentials, configurations, and cloud permissions—rather than abstract model misbehavior.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 值得安全与平台团队关注；这是配置与权限卫生问题，防御路径相对明确。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Worth attention from security and platform teams; this is largely a configuration and permission hygiene issue with a relatively clear defense path.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：代理安全审计与最小权限工具需求上升；风险：公开仓库和宽松云角色易被利用。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: demand may rise for agent security audits and least-privilege tools; risk: public repos and permissive cloud roles are easy to exploit.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并审计自有仓库、应用配置和云角色，移除暴露凭据并收紧权限。
top5.action_en: Read the source and audit your repositories, app configurations, and cloud roles; remove exposed credentials and tighten permissions.

editorial.core_zh: 本期主线是AI从模型能力转向落地与治理：视觉推理新模型、受监管行业规模化应用、人才与平台商业重组，以及代理安全暴露面。
editorial.core_en: The throughline is AI moving from model capability to deployment and governance: a new visual-reasoning model, scaled use in a regulated industry, talent and platform business reshuffling, and agent security exposure.
editorial.trend_zh: 多模态推理、行业治理平台、默认模型分发权、AI代理的凭据与权限安全，正成为更实际的竞争与风险焦点。
editorial.trend_en: Multimodal reasoning, industry governance platforms, default-model distribution power, and credential/permission security for AI agents are becoming the more practical focus of competition and risk.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当代理能自主使用凭据和云权限时，谁来为默认配置的安全负责——平台、企业还是模型提供商？
editorial.next_question_en: When agents can autonomously use credentials and cloud permissions, who is responsible for secure defaults—the platform, the enterprise, or the model provider?
